Definition: from a derivative of G2545; to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively):--sear with a hot iron.
BiblicalUsage: Kauteriazo means to sear with a hot iron, to brand until feeling is gone. 1 Timothy 4:2 warns of men speaking lies in hypocrisy, having their conscience seared with a hot iron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a conscience can be burned until it stops feeling, and that is why I want mine kept tender before God.
